slots.brief: The Ledger Comes Due — The freighter Gray Larkspur sits low at her moorings, hull groaning under debts nobody can pay. A broker in a rain-slick coat wants an answer by sundo
Ink and Interest — Broker Vessic Calloway lays out the contract: the Run, or the ship is seized within the week. He seems to know more about the route than he admits.
A Second Vulture — Financier Orsa Dreth is happy to buy the debt — for a price that trades one noose for another, and a whispered condition: she wants proof of what's re
The Survivor's Warning — Old Mirren lost her whole crew to the Hollow Run and came back alone, half-mad and muttering about a beacon that sings. She presses a hand-drawn map i
Plotting the Impossible Course — Charts spread across the galley table. Three ways into the Hollow Run present themselves: through the fog banks unseen, through Saltspire's watch with
Into the Grey — The fog swallows the horizon whole. Somewhere in it, something old is listening to the creak of your hull.
The Watch at Saltspire — Saltspire's port-wardens are underpaid, overworked, and very interested in the weight of your coin purse.
The Drowned Choir — The strait's namesake becomes horribly clear: shapes rise from the black water, still wearing the tatters of sailors who never made it through.
The Singing Light — A cracked lighthouse rises from a reef that shouldn't exist on any chart, its lamp pulsing with a rhythm too regular to be natural.
What the Light Is Saying — The beacon isn't a warning. It's a summons, coded in pulses of light — and it's calling ships toward something that wants them to arrive.
The Ledgerless Congregation — The signal leads to a cult of ruined sailors who worship the thing beneath the Hollow Run, luring ships to feed it in exchange for calm passage for th
The Congregation Rises — Robed figures pour from the wreck-shrine, and their captain draws a blade that's more coral than steel.
The Heart of the Run — Beyond the shrine, the true Hollow Run opens: a passage where the water itself seems to hold its breath, waiting to see if you're worth swallowing.
Debt Paid in Salt — The Gray Larkspur breaks free of the Hollow Run into open water, hold full of recovered cargo and a story nobody will quite believe. The ledger is cle
What the Run Takes — You make it out — barely, and not with everything you brought in. The ship is battered, the cargo lost to the deep, but the crew is alive and breathin
Added to the Choir — The Hollow Run keeps its record perfect. The Gray Larkspur joins the wrecks below, her crew's names added to whatever ledger the deep keeps for those
